searchText: request for connections, DM if you know anyone https://twitter.com/trent_vanepps/status/1455617719399862277 Can you please reach out to BitPay as well during your crusade? They **force** you to use legacy transactions (effectively) and the transaction will revert if you don't use the fee they picked. I just paid an unnecessary extra 0.003 ETH in unnecessary fees, plus the cost of failed transaction, because of this. <@301186049323958275> quick question why are the fees for swapping a coin on a dex cost more then simply sending eth from one address to another? The fees are a function of cost to the network of the transaction. A more complex transaction will cost more because it used more resources. Interesting thank you for responding
